title: Event forwarding adapters
goal: Deliver raw events through injected services with observer ordering
scopes: raw event forwarding with injected Transformer and Observer
approach: Handle calls Started for a non-nil observer, delegates the original input to the injected Transformer exactly once, calls Finished with the original result only when the error is nil, and returns the original result and error unchanged.
explicit_rules: Do not trim, uppercase, coerce, retry, recover panics, or replace values
Preserve raw input, result, and error identity, including a result returned alongside an error
Started precedes Transform for a non-nil observer; Finished runs only on success
verification: go test ./... passed; covers service substitution, exactly-once delegation, identities, ordering, nil observers, raw values, and panic propagation
constraints: Delegate raw values exactly once; do not normalize or coerce
Observer started before service; finished only on success
required_verification: Service substitution, error identity, and observer ordering tests
